resources.string: Your journal works offline. Sets, equipment settings, check-ins, notes and photos are stored on this phone. A full backup also includes routines and drafts. Keep backups somewhere private.
What is shared with Health Connect
Completed workout summaries can be shared with their start, end and activity type. Google Health and other connected apps can read those summaries.

Steps, sleep and recent heart rate are optional context. They are shown in the app and kept out of your journal. InShape reads its own workout summaries only when you ask it to reconcile a restored workout.

Manage or revoke permissions in Android Health Connect settings. Turning sharing off stops future sharing. Use the workout\'s Health Connect controls to remove a shared summary. A pending removal is retained if access is unavailable.
Use a separate exercise for each machine or way of measuring.
This workout is removed from your journal. If it was shared to Health Connect, it is removed there the next time the app has access.
